## RBAC (Permission-based)

A role maps to a list of permissions in `src/config/permissions.ts`, and routes declare which permission they need:

```ts
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, PermissionsGuard)
@RequirePermissions("admin:access")
```

Add a new role, or change what an existing role can do, by editing `src/config/permissions.ts` only. See `src/admin/admin.controller.ts` for a working example (`GET /api/v1/admin-check`).
